# Penra

> Penra is a private AI second brain for Android that runs entirely on the device: handwriting and PDF to text, voice to text, search by meaning and "ask your notes", with no account and no cloud. On Google Play for Android from 2026-11-12 (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.penra.app); Windows and iOS coming soon.

## Key facts
- Penra is a private "second brain" note app. Everything runs on the device: no account, no cloud.
- Status: available on Google Play for Android from 2026-11-12 (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.penra.app). Windows and iOS versions are coming soon (not available yet).
- Website: https://penra-app.github.io/. Publisher contact: penraapp@gmail.com. X: @PenraOfficial (https://x.com/PenraOfficial). Instagram: @penraofficial (https://www.instagram.com/penraofficial/). YouTube: @PenraOfficial (https://youtube.com/@penraofficial).
- Features: handwriting and PDF to text (photo or PDF, read by an on-device AI model; multi-page documents); voice to text with live text while speaking (speaker separation is a Pro feature); search by meaning; "Ask your notes" (Ask in your own words. Penra writes a short answer from your notes and shows which note it came from; if it's not in your notes, it won't make it up.); write on PDFs, photos and screenshots with pens and highlighter; audio-synced ink (tap a line to hear the audio from that moment); colored folders and tags; stickers and sticky notes; templates and to-do boards; on-device translation; hide private details before sharing; app lock.
- Privacy facts: no account, no sign-up, no Penra server, no analytics, crash-reporting or advertising code. The internet is used only to download AI models (Hugging Face or Oracle Cloud storage) when the user asks. After that the app works offline, including in airplane mode. Notes leave the device only if the user shares or exports them. Verification steps and a measurement: https://penra-app.github.io/verify/
- Languages: the app interface is available in 15 languages (English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Czech, Romanian, Turkish). Handwriting reading is tested most on English and Turkish pages.
- Requirements: Android phone or tablet; 6 GB of RAM or more recommended; the largest reading model needs about 8 GB. The first AI model download is large (about 4 GB measured).
- Performance: a full handwritten page takes about 30 to 60 seconds on a mid-range Android phone because the model runs locally. Messy handwriting can still produce small misreads; text stays editable.
- Pricing: core features (handwriting and PDF reading, voice to text, search by meaning, Ask your notes) are free with no usage limits. Pro adds small extras: speaker separation, some additional AI models and sync (coming soon, not available yet); every install can try Pro free for 7 days with no card, then Pro is monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase through Google Play. (Exact prices are shown in Google Play.)
- Limits: Android only for now; no sync or collaboration yet (sync is coming soon as a Pro feature; there is no Penra cloud today); AI on the device is slower than a cloud server.

## Pages
- [Is there a note app that works offline without an account?](https://penra-app.github.io/offline-note-app-no-account/): Yes. Penra is an Android note app with no account and no cloud: handwriting reading, voice to text, search by meaning and Ask your notes all run on the device.
- [How do I turn handwriting into text offline, without uploading it?](https://penra-app.github.io/handwriting-to-text-offline/): Photograph a handwritten page or pick a PDF and Penra reads it into editable text with an AI model that runs on your Android device. No upload, no account.
- [Is there a Notability alternative for Android that works offline?](https://penra-app.github.io/notability-alternative-android/): Notability reached Android in 2026. Penra is an offline Android alternative with audio-synced ink, folders, stickers, PDF markup and on-device handwriting reading, and no account.
- [Is there an Otter alternative that transcribes on the device instead of the cloud?](https://penra-app.github.io/otter-alternative-on-device/): Penra records and transcribes voice on your Android device, with no account and no cloud. How that differs from Otter, and what Penra cannot do.
- [What is a private second brain app, and how does Penra work?](https://penra-app.github.io/private-second-brain-app/): A second brain keeps what you capture and helps you find and use it later. Penra does this on your Android device: handwriting, PDFs and voice in, search by meaning, and Ask your notes. Ask in your own words. Penra writes a short answer from your notes and shows which note it came from; if it's not in your notes, it won't make it up. No account or cloud.
- [Penra vs Notability, Goodnotes, Samsung Notes, Obsidian, Otter and XNote](https://penra-app.github.io/compare/): sourced side-by-side table, including where Penra is weaker.
- [Best offline AI note app for Android (2026)](https://penra-app.github.io/best-offline-ai-note-app-android/): shortlist of Android notes apps that work offline; where the AI runs, who needs an account, and what Penra private notes can and cannot do.
- [XNote smart pen alternative for Android, no account](https://penra-app.github.io/xnote-alternative-android/): XNote (xnote.ai) pairs a smart pen with cloud AI; Penra private notes for Android reads handwriting, transcribes voice and writes a short answer from your notes on the phone. No account.
- [SoloNote alternative for Android: handwriting, PDFs and voice](https://penra-app.github.io/solonote-alternative-android/): SoloNote by RolledAI (solonote.rolled.ai) is a free, no-account, on-device notes tool for iPhone and Android; Penra private notes for Android adds photographed handwriting, PDFs and voice saved as notes.
- [Uteke alternative for Android: handwriting, PDFs and voice](https://penra-app.github.io/uteke-alternative-android/): Uteke (mobile.uteke.app, not Uteke Cloud) is a search-first Android notes tool with a capped Free plan; Penra private notes for Android adds handwriting, PDFs and uncapped voice to text, with core features free with no limits.
- [Verify it yourself](https://penra-app.github.io/verify/): how to check with Android network counters that Penra sends nothing.
